messages.subject: Simulating a shift
parts:
Hi,

I need some help brainstorming how I am going to simulate a 24-hour day broken up into 3 8-hour shifts for this project.

The setting is a paint can fill line, and operators work for 8 hours with 3 breaks throughout the shift. I am struggling to figure out how to simulate the breaks (which would cause all of the machines on the line to stop running) and string together the shifts into a 24-hour day.

Any thoughts to help get this effort started?

Thanks,
John
